column6: Official events calendar lists the Aug 20 2026 Business Forum plus Nov 13 2026 Utah 100, so the current cycle is scheduled.
Governor's rural summit official page schedules the 2026 edition Aug 4-6 2026 at SUU in Cedar City; that cycle just concluded.
Official site advertises the next Kane County summit for January 2027 at Kanab Event Center and thanks 2026 speakers, so the annual cycle is live.
Deseret News dated 2026-01-24 reports the 10th annual Summit as Feb 4-7 2026 in downtown Salt Lake; the /summit page itself is undated evergreen.
Official site dates Utah Tech Week Oct 26-30 2026 and is taking host applications and attendee registration for that cycle.
Official site schedules the next summit Jan 14 2027 at Dixie Convention Center with a posted agenda and $200 general admission.
EDA FY2025 Disaster Supplemental FAQ posts a March 3 2026 Industry Transformation deadline and rolling Readiness/Implementation windows until funds are exhausted.

Official site offers an undated self-serve 7-day challenge and $47/mo Pro with no posted cohort; about page says 2025-Present; founder podcast runs through 2026-01-28; dropped from Startup State; no current cycle found (RUBRIC-GAP: evergreen self-serve program).
Utah Public Notice records a March 11 2026 Steering Committee meeting with posted packet, CDBG ranking, and audio recording, so the AOG is meeting this cycle.
Forge Utah Meetup lists The Foundry hack nights through Apr 23 2026 at the Draper space; Go West 2025-10-24 is archived and no 2026 conference date is posted.
Clinic blog dated Aug 5 2026 describes ongoing vaccine outreach, and a July 16 2026 post covers June 2026 recognition by the Utah Homeless Services Board.
The Idea Explorer tool at firststepentrepreneur.com/app still loads but carries no date; no current cycle, changelog, or independent dated use found; same undated FSTEP program as the parent listing.
Chamber tourism site schedules Daggett Daze for Sept 5 2026 with open parade and vendor forms; membership page lists it among chamber-sponsored events.
Utah Business dated Feb 12 2025 reports first-year results and ongoing admission; official site is now an undated career-transition toolkit with no 2026 workshop calendar found.
Startup State Jan 30 2026 post names 2026 Builder Day winners after a late-2025 hiatus and says future live pitch events will rotate regions.
Utah delivery partner The Mill posts Cohort 40 opening Sept 2 2026 after a Feb 1-May 20 2026 application window.
Times-Independent reports the May 20 2025 commission created a non-tourism ED/PIO role after folding the old department into tourism; Rural County Grant review was then underway.
Nephi City Jan 14 2025 minutes show chamber officers requesting the annual city contribution and launching a new website; public event pages are undated and the gala listing matches Oct 2 2024.
TechBuzz Nov 5 2025 reports Grix as a participating investor in Mindsmith's $4.1M seed, with founder Randall Lloyd quoted; the grix.vc homepage is an undated Wix splash.
Official RAMP page dates the Spring 2025 cohort March 27-May 29 2025; no 2026 cohort dates are posted, only a notify list.
CAMS post dated June 5 2026 covers Market on Main, which it now organizes through mid-August 2026, citing Park Record reporting.
Chamber Business of the Month page is dated Nov 7 2025; 2026 luncheon, mixer, and annual sponsorships are posted as sold out.
Heber Valley Tourism and Economic Development June 16 2026 release names 25 Wasatch County microgrant recipients from the $90k GOEO-funded cycle.
Official homepage schedules an Aug 20 2026 member networking breakfast and Aug 25 2026 golf tournament and names Greater Zion as July 2026 Business of the Month.
TechBuzz dated May 29 2026 covers the May 21 2026 Founder Graduation luncheon for eight Innovation Forge companies at the Provo facility.
